scope: Epic #12 user journey through the production QML: automation and edits while playing, Undo, Silence now, Save/reopen and export
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform, silent preview clock
verified_behaviors: Clip buttons and Play start both tracks; the tempo field is disabled while playing
Two pointer clicks on the lane draw a one-bar level ramp while playing; the status reads 'while playing', at least two playback edits activate and both clips keep playing
Mute and a step toggle apply while playing; the Undo button reverts the step while playing
Ctrl+. stops playback; Save writes the automated, muted project
A fresh session reopens the same lane points and mute; the float export follows the ramp exactly (0 at the start, linear to full level over bar 1, full level through bar 2)
limits: Offscreen platform with synthetic input and the silent preview clock; native Wayland input and physical audio remain #22 and #19.
